name: Alia
description: Connect Claude to your Alia data to analyze performance on popups for email signups, SMS signups, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://backend.alia-prod.com/mcp/v2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alia MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alia provides these MCP tools: get_event_distributions, get_event_stats, get_poll_answer_distributions, list_campaigns, list_stats, and list_stores.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alia?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alia in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Alia requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alia is developed by Alia Technologies Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
